The response's answer to part (2) is wrong, so it fails. Part (1) is correct: a_n = 3^{2^{n-1}} − 1.

For part (2), the correct derivation uses 1/a_{n+1} = 1/(a_n(a_n+2)) = ½(1/a_n − 1/(a_n+2)). This gives 1/(a_n+2) = 1/a_n − 2/a_{n+1}, so b_n = 2/a_n − 2/a_{n+1}. The sum telescopes to S_n = 2/a_1 − 2/a_{n+1} = 1 − 2/(3^{2^n} − 1).

The response instead gave S_n = ½ − 1/(3^{2^n} − 1), which is exactly half the correct value. Its error comes from an algebra slip: it wrote b_n = 2(a_n+1)/a_{n+1}, then treated this as equal to 1/a_n − 1/a_{n+1}.

A check with n = 1 confirms this. Here b_1 = 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4. The correct formula gives 1 − 2/8 = 3/4. The response's formula gives 1/2 − 1/8 = 3/8.
